info.name: Paper White Technology - LMS API
info.description:
Comprehensive API for the Paper White Technology Loan Management System. Use the Authorize button (JWT-auth) with a Bearer token obtained from POST /auth/login.

Base URL variable: {{baseUrl}} = the server root (default http://localhost:3001). For LAN/emergency access set it to http://<server-ip>:3001. The /api/v1 prefix is already baked into every request path.
Auth: set {{token}} to the accessToken from POST /auth/login.
